title: [Security] Move URL checks from Web Request Helper to System Application Uri module
summary: URL validation moved from Web Request Helper using DotNet System.Uri to native System Application Uri module across multiple apps, with obsolete markers for deprecated procedures.
key_points: Migrated URL validation away from DotNet with IsValidUri, IsValidUriWithoutProtocol, IsSecureHttpUrl, IsHttpUrl, and GetHostNameFromUrl
System Application Uri module now used directly by all callers in Base App, CZ, NA, NO, and specialty apps
Five helper procedures reimplemented on top of Uri codeunit and marked obsolete for CLEAN30
Removed unused System.Integration directives across multiple files
Semantics preserved: absolute URI validation, scheme checking, same error messages
